inlines.v: MEDITERRA'NE MEDITERRA'NEAN MEDITERRA'NEOUS, adjective [Latin medius, middle, and terra, land.] 1. Inclosed or nearly inclosed with land; as the Mediterranean sea, between Europe and Africa. [Mediterrane is not used.] 2. Inland; remote from the ocean or sea; as mediterraneous mountains.
